record_scope_reconstruction: The February22 ministry decision names three distinct pairs: Lavoriškės/Raigardas road operation, Medininkai/Šalčininkai pedestrian-cycle passage, and Kena/Kybartai rail boarding/alighting. Railway Kybartai on Russia frontier is not its road counterpart.

source_checks.finding: Official text makes all three restrictions effective March1 2024 and permits exceptional VSAT rail boarding/alighting cases.

November19 2025 government notice restores Medininkai/Šalčininkai road passage from November20 but says only cars, so does not independently establish pedestrian/cycle reopening. Canonical chronology is left unchanged.
Official directorate homepage links the independently downloaded interactive checkpoint map.
Inspected raw map markers pair named road/rail checkpoints with explicit LatLng values. Road Kybartai and railway Kybartai have different coordinates; mode identity retained.
Official administered-post roster confirms names and road-post addresses; coordinates come from linked map, not inferred address centroids.
